name: waku
description: Waku Memory: durable memory that follows you across sessions and agents. memory.search finds what is known about a task; memory.remember keeps what matters. Muse runs no Waku hooks, so nothing is sent until the agent calls a tool. What the agent passes to a tool is sent to Waku's servers and on to the AI providers that make it searchable, named at www.waku.one/privacy. This is an alpha and its data can be lost.
